entry.name: thisobject
entry.description: Use thisobject as a connection to objects by name. thisobject can be used with global named objects including max and dsp. It can also connect to objects with scripting names, including objects in other patchers using pattr paths. You can also use the name patcher for connecting to the patcher containing the thisobject, which works similarly to the thispatcher object. thisobject is similar to getattr but permits you to change the named target object using the target attribute, whereas getattr uses a patch cord to establish a connection to its target.
